status: Post-development protocol freeze; final scoring not performed

target.meaning: Listed versus not listed in the frozen VulnCheck snapshot, not CISA KEV, future inclusion, EPSS or exploitation probability
target.missing: Abort evaluation if any frozen cohort record lacks a boolean label; no imputation or silent removal

cohort.interpretation: Previously reserved CVEs already exposed in the EPSS study; reused-cohort retrospective evaluation, not a new independent test
cohort.rule: Exact existing CVE IDs; no reassignment, filtering by score, eligibility expansion, or duplicate-CVE inference from shared wording

selection.metric: Mean validation average precision across all three seeds
selection.tie_break: Lexicographically smallest family identifier on exact mean-AP ties
selection.seed_policy: Report every seed and their mean/population SD; no best-seed headline, ensemble, test-selected replacement, or retraining

predictors.policy: Unchanged VK02 v2 source policy, structured encoder, tokenization, SecBERT, security-v4 extractor and saved resource identities
predictors.structured_fit: Use saved train-fitted 29-column encoder without refitting
predictors.text: Apply identical accepted-source rules and source/document/chunk pooling; keep absent sources masked; do not repair text from VK08 error cases inside this evaluation
predictors.prohibited: EPSS and catalogue-derived predictors, label-derived filtering, quarantine metadata as predictors, or evaluation-driven feature changes
predictors.cache: Separate evaluation cache; reuse only exact text/source/offset/processing identities. Build missing chunks under frozen resources without fitting. No rewriting development caches
predictors.failures: Abort incomplete evaluation and record failed CVEs; never silently drop them. A necessary semantic preprocessing fix requires a versioned protocol amendment, not an unrecorded change

decision_rules.neural_source_fits: Freeze existing VK08 maximum-validation-F1 cutoff per checkpoint for all 24 VK07 fits
decision_rules.other_controls: Logistic, prevalence and edge-free controls retain 0.5 only; no new threshold selection
decision_rules.comparability: Compare all models at 0.5 and using AP. Selected-threshold F1 comparisons require both models to have VK08 cutoffs; do not claim superiority from selected neural F1 versus fixed-only controls

reporting.primary_comparison: Mean same-seed AP difference: all-source TPG minus all-source pooled text
reporting.undefined: Report null and its reason when a metric is undefined; do not replace undefined precision/ROC-AUC with zero
tables: known shared wording subsets with original pooled result retained
figures: confusion matrices at fixed and applicable frozen thresholds
reliability plot with fixed 10 equal-width bins and bin counts
paired AP/F1 comparisons with all seeds
reporting.subsets: Shared normalized wording is descriptive, not duplicate identity; report full cohort first and do not select a subgroup winner
reporting.test_metric_sorting: Keep validation-selected primary designation even if another model scores higher later

uncertainty.method: Paired class-stratified CVE bootstrap, percentile 95% intervals
uncertainty.resampling: Resample listed and unlisted CVE indices separately with replacement, preserving class sizes. Use the same draws for every model/seed. Average paired differences across seeds within each draw; never average their probabilities
comparisons: all-source TPG minus matched all-source pooled AP
same comparison F1 at frozen VK08 cutoffs
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional descriptive intervals, not confirmatory significance or a correction for shared evidence, validation selection, prior test exposure or multiple comparisons
uncertainty.single_class: Mark these intervals not estimable if either class is absent

execution.future_release: A separate tested evaluation runner and explicit user authorization are required. Never relax the existing development adapters' test guards
execution.one_evaluation: One complete frozen comparison; verify-only may reproduce it. No test-driven iterations or silent output overwrites
execution.independent_external_evaluation: Not available or claimed here. A new dataset needs its own identity, disjointness/contamination audit and frozen protocol before selection using its labels
